caption: The dashboard Budi (editor) sees: live and draft counts per collection, recently edited entries per language, waiting comments, scheduled entries and submissions.

caption: A published property with unpublished changes: the status card says the draft has changes the site doesn't show yet, next to Publish changes.

caption: The language bar flags the Indonesian translation as Outdated after the English changed, and Used by lists the entries that link here.

title: Edit lock
caption: Opening an entry someone else is editing shows who and since when, with Go back, View only and Take over (their unsaved edits are kept).

title: Page builder with flexible blocks
caption: The Home page editor: intro plus hero and stats blocks, each with a Show switch and drag handle.

title: Scoped permissions per collection
caption: The custom Listings manager role: every action on Properties plus Locations and Amenities terms, nothing else, and it held up when URLs were probed directly.

title: Menu editor
caption: The main menu rebuilt cleanly: listing, term, entry and link items with per-language labels and indent controls.

title: AI access
caption: The AI access page with a read-only and a full token for Ayu, expiry dates and ready-made connect commands (token values hidden).

title: Activity log with AI actions
caption: The activity log records every change an AI agent made through MCP, labelled with the token's name.

title: Saving a nested menu duplicates items
caption: After a second save with no changes, Neighbourhoods, Journal and Team appear twice in the main menu, with the Indonesian label on only one copy.

title: Page parent needs a separate Save settings
caption: The Parent picked in Page settings is only saved by its own Save settings button, while the header already says Published.

title: Reorder mixes page levels
caption: After reordering, child pages (Sell, Rent, Property management) sit between unrelated top-level pages in one flat list.

title: Indonesian listing hides untranslated properties
caption: /id/properties lists 6 properties while /properties lists 15, although every untranslated property works at /id through the fallback.

title: English validation on an Indonesian form
caption: On /id/kontak the summary is Indonesian but each field error is English and uses the blueprint's English label ("The Name field is required.").

title: Two-factor switch shows on after turning it off
caption: Right after saving two-factor login as off, the switch springs back to on although the database holds off.

title: Kept page after a deploy
caption: A page kept by the page cache before npm run build links the deleted CSS file and renders unstyled until the cache TTL ends.

title: Login reveals non-panel accounts
caption: A correct password for an account without panel access gets "This account can't use the admin panel.", confirming both the account and its password.

title: SEO from fields lists every blueprint's fields
caption: The Neighbourhoods collection's SEO Description picker offers fields from every blueprint, including form and global blueprints.

title: Ctrl+K finds nothing on the Dashboard
caption: The command palette on the Dashboard answers "Nothing found." for Menteng, while the same search on CMS pages lists four entries.

title: Scheduled entry shows a Published button
caption: A scheduled property has a Scheduled chip but a disabled "Published" main button and no way to unschedule from the header.

title: Wide logo squeezed into a square
caption: A 208x56 wordmark chosen as the panel logo is cropped to "UM / TATES" in the preview and shrunk into the square sidebar tile.

title: Bare 429 page after five form tries
caption: The sixth contact form submit within a minute, failed validation included, gets Laravel's unstyled 429 page and the typed message is lost.

title: Indonesian globals start empty
caption: Switching the Company global to Indonesian shows empty translatable fields, including the whole Primary contact group, with no fallback note.
